data.narrative:
Bedrock Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Joselyn Lai, Silviu Livescu, and Joel Wishkovsky, having raised $15M+ to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes eight private peers and one public comparable (LNZA), though no subset of peers shares sufficient stage, timing, and valuation alignment to support a reliable peer-median approach.

Given data constraints, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using the $15M total raised as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage capital step-ups yields an implied valuation of $30M. This represents a standard progression assumption absent company-specific operational or market traction data.

The triangulated range is $26M to $34M, centered on $30M. Material uncertainties remain: the peer universe (Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Enovix) operates at varying scales and development stages, none directly comparable on timing or technology specificity. The absence of narrow peer multiples means the step-up multiplier carries outsized weight. Investors should ground this range against Bedrock's specific unit economics, technology maturity, capital efficiency, and competitive positioning within climate tech before proceeding.
